items.title: Benny Golson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Bill was our mentor. Bill Barron was something.

ctx.x: We’re going to take a minute or two. So when we take a break we’ll come back, talk about that. I’d like to also talk about the Barron brothers. I want to make sure we get that.
Yeah. It was all about Bill. Bill was our mentor. Bill Barron was something. People don’t know.
But they’re going to know now, because you’re going to tell them.
